question: Identify the antonym of "Denounce"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Defend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Denounce"** means to publicly declare someone or something to be wrong or evil. It often implies strong disapproval or condemnation. (आरोप लगाना, निंदा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The activist denounced the unethical practices of the corporation.
 
 
 
• **"Defend"** means to protect someone or something from harm or criticism, or to argue in support of something or someone. (रक्षा करना, समर्थन करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The lawyer defended his client against the false accusations.
 
 
 
• Since "Defend" is opposite to "Denounce," it is the correct antonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Defend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Condemn** (निंदा करना): To express complete disapproval, typically in public.
 
 
• **Example:** The government condemned the violent acts carried out by the protesters.
 
 
 
• **Accuse** (आरोप लगाना): To charge someone with a fault or offense.
 
 
• **Example:** The witness accused the suspect of being involved in the crime.
 
 
 
• **Blame** (दोष देना): To assign responsibility for a fault or wrong.
 
 
• **Example:** He blamed his teammate for the failure of the project.
